result.instructions: Tools for dilisense, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Screen Jane Doe, born 1980, against sanctions and PEP lists."; "Does the company Acme Trading LLC appear on any sanctions list?"; "Check this customer's name for adverse media from the last two years.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes dilisense data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run dilisense_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run dilisense_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run dilisense_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. dilisense_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: dilisense_check_individual
tools.title: Screen individual
tools.description: Screen a person against sanction, PEP (politically exposed person) and criminal watchlists. Give search_all or names, not both. Each call uses one of your monthly calls. For your own KYC/AML screening only. dilisense API: GET /v1/checkIndividual.

search_all.description: Text checked against all fields of each list record. Use this or names, not both.

names.description: Text checked against name fields only. Use this or search_all, not both.

fuzzy_search.description: Spelling tolerance for names: 1 allows one letter difference, 2 allows two. Omit for exact matching.

dob.description: Date of birth dd/mm/yyyy. Use 00 for an unknown day or month, e.g. 00/00/1990.

gender.description: Gender filter. Records with no gender are still returned.

citizenship.description: Citizenship as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. DE.

includes.description: Source IDs to search, comma-separated, plus 'included' for your key's sources. Omit for your key's sources. IDs come from dilisense_list_source_lists.

tools.name: dilisense_check_entity
tools.title: Screen entity
tools.description: Screen a company or other legal entity against sanction, PEP and criminal watchlists. Legal-form terms such as LLC or GmbH match their synonyms. Give search_all or names, not both. Each call uses one of your monthly calls. For your own KYC/AML screening only. dilisense API: GET /v1/checkEntity.

search_all.description: Text checked against all fields of each list record. Use this or names, not both.

names.description: Text checked against name fields only. Use this or search_all, not both.

fuzzy_search.description: Spelling tolerance for names: 1 allows one letter difference, 2 allows two. Omit for exact matching.

includes.description: Source IDs to search, comma-separated, plus 'included' for your key's sources. Omit for your key's sources. IDs come from dilisense_list_source_lists.

tools.name: dilisense_media_check_individual
tools.title: Screen individual for adverse media
tools.description: Search adverse media news for a person: fraud, crime, corruption and similar reports, by category. Give search_all or names, not both. Each call uses one of your monthly calls. For your own KYC/AML screening only. dilisense API: GET /v1/media/checkIndividual.

search_all.description: Text checked against all fields of each list record. Use this or names, not both.

names.description: Text checked against name fields only. Use this or search_all, not both.

start_date.description: Only articles from this date (yyyy-mm-dd) until today.

publication_country.description: Countries the articles are published in, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, comma-separated. Prefix a code with - to exclude it.

fetch_articles.description: Include the article texts. Default false. Each category returns at most 10 articles.

tools.name: dilisense_list_source_lists
tools.title: List source lists
tools.description: List the screening source lists in the dilisense database with their IDs, types and countries. Use the IDs in the includes parameter of the screening tools. scope 'included' (default) shows the lists your key searches. dilisense API: GET /v1/getSourceList.

scope.description: 'included' (default): the lists your key searches. 'all': the full catalogue.
